usageNotes: Use this as the primary inventory sweep across all PDM-managed remotes — it returns nodes, VMs, containers, storage, datastores, and networks in one call grouped by remote. Results are served from a cache; lower `max-age` (e.g. 0) forces a live fetch at the cost of higher latency, while the 30-second default is appropriate for dashboards. If a remote is unreachable, its entry will contain an `error` field alongside an empty or partial `resources` array rather than failing the entire response.

examples.summary: Fetch only running QEMU VMs across all remotes with a fresh cache

tips: Each top-level array item maps to one remote; always check the `error` field on each item before processing its `resources` — a reachable remote returns null/omitted error, an unreachable one may still appear with an error string.
The `type` discriminator property on each resource entry (e.g. pve-qemu, pbs-datastore) is the reliable way to branch parsing logic — do not rely on which fields are present.
Omitting `resource-type` returns all resource kinds in one pass, which is more efficient than making separate filtered requests when you need a full inventory.
The `view` parameter (2-32 chars, alphanumeric/dot/dash/underscore) selects a saved PDM view; omit it to get the unfiltered resource list.
The `search` parameter syntax is not yet documented (spec contains a TODO); treat it as experimental and prefer `resource-type` for reliable filtering.
